title: Growth Channel Incubation & Product Strategy Director
description:
Overview
As the Growth Channel Incubation & Product Strategy Director , you will identify, shape, and prove the next generation of growth capabilities across Microsoft product surfaces. You will work at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, marketing, customer experience, and business growth to determine where new product-led growth opportunities exist and what Microsoft must build to realize them.
This is a builder role, not a traditional campaign management role. You will develop growth hypotheses, translate customer and business opportunities into product and capability requirements, influence product roadmaps, and lead incubation from concept through evidence-based scale, iteration, or stop decisions. You will establish the initial strategy, partnerships, success measures, and operating model for new capabilities, then transition proven capabilities to the teams responsible for activation and scaled operations.
Responsibilities
•    Define the next growth opportunities: Identify product surfaces, customer moments, ecosystem signals, and emerging capabilities that could become new growth channels. Develop a clear point of view on where Microsoft should invest and why.
•    Create product-led growth strategy: Translate customer needs and growth opportunities into strategies, value propositions, product requirements, experience principles, and measurable growth hypotheses.
•    Influence product and engineering roadmaps: Build trusted partnerships with senior product, engineering, design, data, and marketing leaders. Represent growth requirements early in product planning and influence what is built, how it is instrumented, and how it can be activated.
•    Lead incubation from concept to proof: Design and lead pilots that test new channel mechanics, customer experiences, and product capabilities. Establish success criteria, learning agendas, dependencies, and decision points before work begins.
•    Drive evidence-based investment decisions: Synthesize customer, performance, technical, and business evidence to recommend whether capabilities should scale, iterate, or stop. Communicate recommendations clearly to executive stakeholders.
•    Build reusable capabilities, not one-off programs: Create repeatable frameworks, design patterns, playbooks, governance, and initial operating models that enable successful concepts to be used across products, audiences, and growth motions.
•    Establish capability handoffs: Define readiness criteria and partner with growth activation and channel operations leaders to transition proven capabilities into scaled execution with clear ownership, documentation, and measurement.
•    Shape the external and internal point of view: Develop a deep understanding of product-led growth practices inside and outside Microsoft. Apply relevant insights to Microsoft’s ecosystem and articulate a compelling vision for how growth capabilities should evolve.
•    Lead through influence: Drive clarity and momentum across complex, cross-organizational initiatives without relying on direct authority. Anticipate barriers, align stakeholders, make tradeoffs visible, and accelerate decisions.
Qualifications

Overview
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for Microsoft's Forensics platform, a highly sensitive, large-scale distributed data platform supporting critical security and investigative scenarios.
The engineer will work across the Forensics Pipeline, from Substrate-based data capture and services through Azure COSMIC-based processing and Synapse data pipelines. The role requires deep distributed-systems expertise and the ability to reason about reliability, scalability, data quality, security, privacy, operational efficiency, and cost across an end-to-end production system.
We are looking for an AI-native engineer who makes AI a core part of how they design and build software. This includes using AI to accelerate code development and comprehension, explore designs, prototype solutions, automate testing, diagnose production issues, analyze telemetry, improve developer workflows, and increase overall engineering velocity and quality. The engineer will also help identify opportunities to apply AI to previously difficult engineering problems while maintaining engineering judgment, security, privacy, and accountability for AI-generated artifacts.
This engineer will be expected to own complex technical areas end to end, develop and review production code, drive architecture and design decisions, lead work across organizational boundaries, and raise the technical capabilities and engineering practices of the broader team. These expectations align with Microsoft's Principal-level guidance around broad technical depth, cross-team leadership, architecture, mentorship, and proactive ownership of complex technical challenges.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Lead AI-native engineering practices across the team, using AI throughout the software development lifecycle to accelerate design, coding, testing, debugging, code comprehension, documentation, and operational analysis.
Identify and develop new ways to use AI to solve complex engineering problems, improve developer productivity, automate repetitive engineering work, and increase the speed and quality of software delivery.
Champion the responsible use of AI-generated code and engineering artifacts, ensuring appropriate human review and adherence to security, privacy, quality, and Responsible AI practices.
Provide technical leadership for the Forensics Pipeline, driving architecture and engineering decisions across large-scale distributed data-processing systems spanning Substrate, Azure COSMIC, Synapse, storage, routing, transformation, and related platform components.
Own complex engineering problems end to end, from requirements and architecture through implementation, validation, deployment, telemetry, production operation, and continuous improvement.
Design and build high-scale, resilient, and cost-efficient distributed systems, considering throughput, capacity, reliability, failure isolation, disaster recovery, performance, security, privacy, and COGS.
Remain deeply hands-on with production code, primarily using C# and Python, including implementation, debugging, testing, code reviews, performance analysis, automation, and production troubleshooting.
Work extensively within the Substrate codebase, understanding complex dependencies and safely introducing changes into mature, business-critical infrastructure.
Develop and operate large-scale data-processing solutions using Azure COSMIC and Synapse, including transformation, orchestration, storage, capacity management, deployment, and operational troubleshooting.
Establish end-to-end observability and measurable engineering outcomes, using telemetry to understand reliability, latency, capacity, operational health, and production behavior.
Lead architecture and design reviews, identify technical risks early, evaluate alternatives and tradeoffs, and produce clear technical proposals for complex or ambiguous engineering problems.
Drive engineering excellence, including secure-by-design development, automated testing, code quality, safe deployment, maintainability, operational readiness, incident prevention, and production support.
Diagnose difficult production problems using telemetry and code and data analysis; lead root-cause investigations and ensure learnings translate into durable engineering improvements.
Collaborate across Substrate, Azure, security, and partner teams, driving technical alignment and resolving complex cross-team dependencies.
Mentor and develop other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, technical guidance, experimentation, and sharing of engineering best practices.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Solid understanding of the responsible application of AI in software engineering, including human accountability for AI-generated code and artifacts, validation, security, privacy, and appropriate engineering controls.
Solid software engineering proficiency with C#/.NET and Python, including the ability to design and implement production-quality systems.
Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud services.

title: Principal Software Engineer Manager, Windows Hardware Security
description:
Overview
Windows Security protects Windows from the hardware up. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer Manager to lead the engineering organization responsible for some of the foundational technologies that establish trust across Windows devices and cloud services.
Modern platform security depends on establishing trust across the full stack, from silicon and firmware through the operating system and into cloud services. Hardware Security builds the technologies that establish and protect that trust, including Microsoft Pluton, hardware-rooted platform security capabilities, and cloud-based device attestation services.
In this role, you will lead a broad engineering organization that develops security firmware and software shipping on Windows devices, advances Microsoft Pluton as an integrated security foundation for the Windows ecosystem, and builds and operates cloud services that allow devices and services to establish and prove their security state. The team partners across Windows, Azure, Microsoft Security, silicon and device partners, and industry standards organizations to advance platform security for billions of Windows customers.
This is a highly technical leadership role at the intersection of silicon, operating systems, security, and cloud services. We are looking for a leader who can set technical direction in complex and rapidly evolving areas, develop outstanding engineering leaders and teams, and turn emerging security threats and technologies into durable protections for customers.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Lead the engineering strategy and execution for Windows Hardware Security, spanning Microsoft Pluton, hardware and firmware security, hardware-rooted platform security capabilities, and cloud-based attestation services.
Define and drive a cohesive chip-to-cloud security architecture that connects hardware roots of trust with Windows security capabilities and cloud services.
Advance Microsoft Pluton as a foundation for security innovation in the Windows ecosystem, working across hardware, firmware, operating system, and service boundaries to deliver new protections for customers.
Lead the engineering and evolution of Windows attestation services, enabling devices and services to establish identity, integrity, and trusted security state using hardware-backed security signals.
Lead the design, development, delivery, and operation of security-critical software, firmware, and services with a focus on security, reliability, scalability, performance, quality, and operational excellence.
Partner with silicon vendors, device manufacturers, industry standards organizations, and engineering teams across Microsoft to influence hardware security architecture and bring emerging security capabilities into the Windows ecosystem.
Identify emerging threats and technology shifts and translate them into engineering strategy, product roadmaps, and systematic security improvements.
Drive engineering excellence across both Windows product engineering and cloud service development, including architecture, testing, telemetry, reliability, incident response, secure development, and live-site operations.
Create clarity across complex cross-organizational initiatives, make thoughtful engineering and business tradeoffs, and drive accountability for delivering customer outcomes.
Build, coach, and grow a high-performing organization of engineering managers and engineers, developing technical leaders and fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Represent Microsoft and Windows Security with senior internal and external partners on critical hardware, platform security, and attestation topics.
Leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve engineering effectiveness, security analysis, operational efficiency, and the team's ability to respond to an evolving threat landscape.

title: Senior Copilot Business Analyst
description:
Overview
The Microsoft 365 & Copilot for Individuals team is looking for a data-fluent, business-minded Senior Copilot Business Analyst to help shape how we understand and improve the Copilot usage in the core Microsoft 365 apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneDrive; from product usage and engagement through paywall interactions and Premium subscription upgrades.
The Microsoft 365 for Individuals team owns end-to-end marketing experiences for consumers across Microsoft 365 subscriptions and individual products in the portfolio.
In this role, you will build and own the usage consumption-to-upgrade measurement framework, helping the business understand the factors that influence Copilot engagement and subscription conversion. You will evaluate opportunities across key levers, including usage growth, engagement intensity, paywall experiences, campaigns, and in-product surfaces.
You will also help establish attribution across customer touchpoints and turn complex behavioral data, business performance signals, and research into clear recommendations that influence marketing, product, and investment decisions.
This role is great for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, marketing, product, and business strategy. You will work deeply with data, but your most important deliverable is not the dashboard. It is the insight, recommendation, or decision that comes from it.
The successful candidate will bring proficient analytical rigor, marketing and customer fluency, curiosity, and an ability to communicate complex insights in ways that enable action. You will also have opportunities to apply AI tools to modern marketing and analytical challenges.
What Success Looks Like?
Success in this role means helping the organization move beyond simply reporting what happened to understanding why it happened, what matters most, and what we should do next.
You will help create a shared understanding of the Copilot customer journey, identify the opportunities with the highest potential to improve engagement and subscription conversion, and provide leaders and partner teams with trusted insights they can use to make better decisions.
Responsibilities
The Senior Copilot Business Analyst key responsibilites:
Build and evolve the Copilot subscription usage to upgrade funnel: Define the measurement approach for the customer journey from Copilot usage and engagement through paywall interactions and Premium subscription upgrades.
Identify opportunities to improve conversion: Model key growth and conversion levers, including usage growth, engagement intensity, customer behavior, paywall mechanics, and other factors influencing subscription upgrades.
Own the measurement framework: Establish KPIs, definitions, data sources, and measurement standards for Copilot consumption across Microsoft 365 consumer applications, while identifying instrumentation and data gaps that need to be addressed.
Advance attribution capabilities: Parter with product, marketing tech, and data science teams to develop approaches for understanding which campaigns, channels, in-product surfaces, entry points, and customer touchpoints contribute to Copilot engagement and subscription conversion.
Turn data into business recommendations: Analyze behavioral and performance data to explain what changed, why it changed, and what actions teams should consider across audiences, applications, features, cohorts, lifecycle stages, and customer experiences.
Influence product and marketing priorities: Partner with product and marketing teams to evaluate how initiatives are affecting the customer funnel and identify opportunities with the highest potential to improve engagement and subscription outcomes.
Support planning and forecasting: Collaborate with Finance and business partners on target setting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and investment prioritization while helping teams evaluate the assumptions behind business plans.
Strengthen data quality and accessibility: Partner with engineering, analytics, and data science teams to define measurement requirements, prioritize data pipelines, and ensure business-critical reporting is reliable, timely, and trusted.
Use AI to enhance analytical capabilities: Apply AI tools to accelerate analysis, uncover insights, explore patterns, improve reporting, and develop more effective ways of understanding business performance.
Communicate insights with clarity: Translate complex analytical findings into compelling narratives and recommendations that help technical and non-technical stakeholders make informed decisions.
Other
Embody our  culture  and  values .
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 3+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 6+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 8+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience .
8+ years of experience in one or more areas such as business analytics, business planning, marketing analytics, product analytics, data science, growth analytics, strategy, or another quantitative discipline .
Experience working with product and marketing data to uncover insights, evaluate performance, and support business decisions

Experience supporting a consumer subscription, freemium, digital product, or growth-oriented business.
Deep hands-on data skills, with demonstrated fluency building analysis and reporting from large behavioral datasets.

Reviews product code and test code to ensure it meets team standards, contains the correct test coverage, and is appropriate for the product or solution area. Conducts code reviews in a timely fashion that helps accelerate the pace of development on the team. Considers diagnosability, reliability, testability, and maintainability when reviewing code, and understands when code is ready to be shared or delivered. Drives the refinement of products through data analytics, and makes informed decisions in engineering products through data integration. Reviews designs/architectures within and across teams to provide recommendations for improvements.

Shares best practices and teaches others about new tools and strategies.

You will own our automation and tooling roadmap and lead the strategy to connect data across CO+I and partner organizations into a trusted, shared foundation. You will find where automation and AI can eliminate manual work and streamline handoffs, giving our program managers the data and tools they need to rapidly scale Microsoft's global AI fleet.

You won't design the tools yourself, but you'll know our data and processes well enough to ask precise questions, challenge assumptions, and hold your own in technical discussions with engineering partners. You can see past individual requests to the underlying problem, make clear tradeoffs when everything feels urgent, and bring diverse stakeholders together around a shared vision.

Assess current processes, tools, and workflows to find gaps, manual effort, handoffs, and chances to apply automation or AI.
Build and drive a strategy to connect data across CO+I and partner organizations so we have a single source of truth, fewer reconciliation steps, and better decision-making.
Own intake and prioritization of new tool and feature requests. Use clear criteria to keep engineering resources focused on the projects with the highest business impact.

You should be comfortable reasoning about risk, designing for diagnosability and graceful degradation, and creating engineering practices that raise the reliability bar for the entire team.

 - Lead firmware architecture for embedded systems spanning boot, RTOS/runtime behavior, peripheral control, power management, communications, and field diagnostics.

 - Define engineering standards for reliability, fault tolerance, observability, and maintainability across the firmware stack.

 - Partner closely with engineers in hardware, software, and AI research from early prototype through production.

 - Build rigorous bring-up, validation, and release processes for embedded platforms.

 - Establish testing strategies across unit, hardware-in-the-loop, integration, stress, and failure-injection testing.

 - Drive root-cause analysis for subtle hardware, firmware, and system interactions.

 - Make clear tradeoffs across performance, memory, power, schedule, and safety.

 - Mentor firmware engineers and help shape a culture of urgency, technical rigor, practical judgment, and high-quality execution.

 - Have extensive experience developing firmware in an iterative environment.

 - Get a thrill from bringing up new hardware and taking end-to-end ownership over ensuring it works.

 - Have led architecture and delivery for complex embedded products that shipped to real users or operated in demanding production environments.

 - Are deeply fluent in low-level languages (we use Rust!) and comfortable working close to hardware under real-time constraints.

 - Understand embedded systems from first principles, including interrupts, scheduling, memory layout, buses, DMA, timing behavior, and failure modes.

 - Experience with Rust in embedded environments.

 - Experience with Embassy or other async embedded Rust frameworks.

title: Strategic Finance Manager
location: Palo Alto, California, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
description:
ABOUT QUINCE
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
OUR CULTURE
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.
If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
THE ROLE
Strategic Finance Manager
This role reports into the Head of Corporate Finance/FP&A and serves as a senior strategic finance partner to leadership across the business. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in investment banking and corporate finance, with experience supporting complex, high-growth businesses—ideally within eCommerce, consumer, or other fast-paced, technology-enabled environments. They demonstrate advanced analytical judgment and deep expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and strategic analysis, along with fluency in Excel, financial planning systems, and data visualization tools.
This individual is expected to independently lead high-visibility financial initiatives, translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership, and serve as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders. Success in this role requires comfort operating in ambiguity, a proactive problem-solving mindset, and the ability to scale processes and insights alongside a rapidly growing business. This person is required to be in office 4 days a week in San Francisco, CA or Palo Alto, CA.
Responsibilities
Serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership, owning forecasting, long-range planning, and performance analysis across key areas of the business.
Build and maintain sophisticated financial models to support strategic decisions, including scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and business case development.
Lead the annual operating plan and quarterly re-forecast processes, driving alignment on assumptions, targets, and resource allocation.
Partner cross-functionally with teams across the company to translate operational drivers into financial outcomes and identify opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
Develop and track key company KPIs and unit economics, connecting operational performance to broader financial outcomes such as contribution margin, cash flow, and enterprise value.
Prepare and evolve Weekly Business Review (WBR) and board-level materials, synthesizing complex analyses into clear, actionable narratives for executive leadership and investors.
Deliver high-impact ad hoc analyses on strategic initiatives, investments, pricing, and growth opportunities to inform decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting infrastructure, and planning systems to scale with the business.
Qualifications
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
4 - 8 years of progressive experience, ideally combining investment banking or corporate finance with FP&A, strategic finance, or a similar role supporting complex, operationally intensive businesses, preferably in retail, consumer, eCommerce, or supply chain driven environments.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted strategic finance partner, influencing decisions through strong cross-functional collaboration with operational, commercial, and technical teams.
Deep expertise in financial modeling, scenario analysis, and business case development, with a track record of evaluating tradeoffs and informing high-impact decisions.
Strong understanding of unit economics and customer economics, including contribution margin drivers, cost structures, and the financial implications of operational and growth investments.
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including complex models and sensitivity analyses, along with hands-on experience using financial planning and reporting systems (e.g., Adaptive, Anaplan, Hyperion, NetSuite, or similar tools).
Solid command of accounting and finance fundamentals, including GAAP, general ledger review, and financial controls, with the ability to partner effectively with Accounting teams.
Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear insights that influence executive decision-making.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting structured financial narratives and recommendations to senior leadership.
High attention to detail paired with the ability to manage competing priorities and ambiguity in a fast-paced, scaling environment.
A proactive, intellectually curious mindset, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and propose thoughtful, data-backed solutions.
Preferred:
Master's Degree (MBA) or relevant certifications (e.g., CFA)
Investment banking and/or private equity experience
Finance experience in a retail, e-commerce, consumer goods, or supply chain–driven industry

Experience taking a project from requirements and design through implementation, rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and communicating trade-offs clearly. Practical understanding of model inference and evaluation, including held-out datasets, generalization, reproducibility and model versioning, and the differences between open-loop replay, closed-loop simulation and real-world measurements. Experience with Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable distributed data systems, and with AWS, Docker or GitLab CI. Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks, evaluation of end-to-end driving models, or connecting offline model metrics to closed-loop and real-world driving behavior. description:
As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.
Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!
Hours
6:00 am- 2:30 pm (Monday- Friday) OT 2 hours after your shift
Saturdays every other Saturday am - 10am
Compensation
At S&C, we provide competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, with a commitment to transparency in our pay practices. The  hourly pay rate for this position is $20.25. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual short-term incentive bonus, subject to eligibility criteria.
Join Our Team as an Assembler!
Are you passionate about assembly? S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to join our Vista & Vista SD Assembly team. As an Assembler, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team.
In this job, you will assemble VISTA units and corresponding subassemblies. You will work in a production environment, engage in continuous productive activity, and must meet requirements within time constraints. This is an assembly line operation involving as many as six stations. Initially you will be assigned to one station but will need to be flexible and open to working additional stations as business needs require. Tasks require a high degree of eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity, and the use of both hands and arms on a repetitive basis for a full range of motion. You will frequently use hand and power tools; occasionally work while standing on ladders; and occasionally work inside tight compartments.
Key Responsibilities:
Assemble VISTA Switch, both on the assembly line and directly on the shop floor.
Identify, transport, install, mount and bolt all types of components (ranging from 5 lbs. to 50 lbs., with assistance), including bus assemblies, high-voltage switches, mounting and support plates, lock assemblies,
Perform mechanical inspection using torque wrenches, screwdrivers, and tape measures.
Have proficiency in the use of simple material handling equipment, hand tools, power tools, simple gauges, instruments and overhead cranes.
Operate simple machinery such as automatic Press machines.
Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, blueprints, and manufacturing drawings.
Measure, cut, route, bundle, and label wires according to engineering specifications.
Use hand tools and specialized equipment such as crimpers, wire strippers, cutters, heat guns, and torque tools.
Crimp terminals, lugs, connectors, and other electrical components in accordance with established standards.
Verify wire sizes, colors, routing, and terminations against drawings and work instructions.
Conduct continuity checks and basic electrical inspections to ensure proper assembly.
Identify and report material shortages, drawing discrepancies, quality concerns, or process issues.
Work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Production teams to meet customer and production requirements.
What you’ll Need to Succeed:
High School/GED diploma required.
Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical operations.
Demonstrated ability to use basic shop math and measurement tools such as tape measures.
Ability to follow standard work instructions, assembly drawings, and specifications.
Knowledge and ability to use air impact tools and other hand-held tools.
2 years of mechanical assembly and/or electrical wiring experience. Candidates with electrical or mechanical trade school education may also be considered.
Preferred:
Previous experience in an assembly or manufacturing environment a plus.
Physical demands:
Standing: All tasks are performed in a standing position with intermittent walking.
Lifting: Frequent lifting of items ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 50 lbs.
Walking: Occasional walking moderate distances (less than 1/8 mile).
Carrying: Frequent carrying of items ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 25 lbs.
Pushing: Occasional pushing of motorized material handling carts with loaded weights up to 1000 lbs.
Pulling: Occasional pulling of motorized material handling carts with loaded weights up to 1000 lbs.
Bending: Frequent bending and crouching to safely lift parts of various sizes and shapes.
Reaching: Continuous full range of motion from above the shoulders to below the knees.
Handling: Continuous handling of parts ranging in weight from 5 lbs. to 50 lbs.
Other: Respirator certification required.

description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role
Samsara's AI Experience team builds the Samsara Assistant and Agent Studio, where customers create chat and voice agents that work across their safety, maintenance and operations data.
Agent Studio is now generally available, and usage across chat and voice has more than tripled since June 2026.
This is a new role. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead the teams behind the Assistant, Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility. Your job is to turn a fast-growing product into one customers trust and come back to every day: making answers trustworthy, getting more customers to try agents, and turning first-time users into daily ones.
This team is both a platform and a product. About half the work is helping engineering teams across Samsara, from Safety to Maintenance, build and launch their own agents. The other half is the frameworks those agents run on, used by Samsara teams and customers alike.
You'll lead about 10 machine learning engineers, applied scientists and full-stack engineers through two tech leads. The individual contributor bench is strong, so your first focus is scaling the product.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.
What makes Samsara different
Mission-driven impact. We improve safety, efficiency and sustainability for the industries that power the global economy.
A unique data advantage. IoT data at a scale few companies can match — 30+ trillion data points a year, 70+ billion miles driven.
Hands-on leadership and builder culture. Leaders at every level stay close to the product and the code.
Fast decisions, limited bureaucracy. Work directly with senior leadership and ship solutions that matter.
Growth and learning. Roles grow quickly here as the business grows. We invest heavily in R&D and in building for the long term.
Scale with startup energy. A public company (NYSE: IOT) with the resources and reach of scale, and the agility and pace of a high-growth technology company.
What makes this opportunity unique
Trusted answers for the people who keep the world running.  Operators in transportation, construction, utilities and field services ask the Assistant about their drivers, vehicles and equipment. Your team makes sure the answers are right.
Just launched, already growing. Agent Studio went GA in October 2026. Chat and voice volume grew from about 100K in June to more than 350K, and power users are up week over week.
Platform and product at once. Your work powers agents across every Samsara product line and generates revenue for Samsara.
A new leadership seat. This is the first management layer for a team that has outgrown one manager. You shape how it works from day one.
In this role, you will
Own Assistant & Agent Studio and Agent Extensibility, leading about 10 engineers through two tech leads.
Grow activation, so more customers try agents, through recommended questions, automatically generated reports and proactive agents.
Drive answer quality and repeat usage, so customers trust what the Assistant tells them and come back daily.
Set technical direction through RFCs and design reviews for a platform used by customers and Samsara teams.
Raise the bar for how the team builds with AI, across coding, evaluation and operations.
Partner with product teams across Safety, Maintenance and more to build and launch their agents on the platform.
Champion Samsara’s cultural principles — Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team — as we scale globally.
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team.
Minimum requirements
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams.
Experience managing engineering teams and tech leads.
Experience across both machine learning and software engineering, including building agentic systems and traditional production software.
A track record of shipping production systems used at scale by external customers, B2B or B2C.
Experience building zero-to-one products in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field.
An ideal candidate also has
Agent platform depth. Has designed and scaled an agent platform that other teams build on.
User-facing AI products. Has built AI products that customers use directly, not only backend agents.
Growth and activation experience. Has moved activation or retention with recommendations, proactive experiences or usage loops.
Answer-quality rigor. Has set up evaluations and quality metrics for LLM-powered products.
Mixed-team leadership. Is comfortable leading machine learning engineers, applied scientists and full-stack engineers on one team.
An advanced degree.  A Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field.
You should apply if
You are motivated by impact. You want to see a product you lead change how thousands of operators run their day.
You blend machine learning and software engineering. You've built agentic systems and traditional production software, and you're comfortable going deep on either.
You build from zero to one. You've taken products from idea to launch and know what to cut to ship.
You are AI-forward. You live and breathe AI like we do.
You care about the user. You think in activation, repeat usage and trust, not only in models and infrastructure.
You lead through others. You set direction with tech leads, grow people and raise the bar for design and execution.
You enable and collaborate with other teams. You enjoy building platforms that partner teams adopt and succeed with.
See Samsara in action
If you like, we would like to invite you to spend ten minutes getting to know us.
A quick video introducing our business (click here for the Youtube Video).
2026 Agent Studio reveal at Beyond, our annual customer event (click here for the Youtube Video and fast forward to 59:36)

Champion next-generation device and accessory programs from bold concept stages through EVT, DVT, PVT, explosive ramp, and full mass production, taking full ownership of the end-to-end supply chain master plan

Manage high-impact engineering changes with precision, driving seamless inventory disposition and cutover plans

Revolutionize supply chain operations with cutting-edge AI and automation
Architect high-leverage playbooks, intelligent workflows, and custom tooling that supercharge productivity across the entire global supply chain organization
Transform complex data into game-changing insights through futuristic dashboards, predictive risk analytics, and compelling executive briefings
Pioneer autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to handle routine program tasks, status roll-ups, and data pulls, freeing your bandwidth for high-value strategic leadership
Champion emerging AI advancements and translate state-of-the-art tech into transformative, real-world operational advantages
Maintain hyper-accurate, modernized supply chain tracking infrastructure across ERP/PLM platforms, PR/PO tracking, and program dashboards
Embody and lead as an inspirational Samsara leader
Embody and champion Samsara's core cultural ethos—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—inspiring everyone around you to achieve extraordinary results

7+ years of experience in supply chain program management, NPI, or operations for hardware or electronics products, with a track record of taking products from concept to mass production
BS in a relevant field (Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain) or equivalent practical experience
Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
Strong understanding of the NPI lifecycle and builds (EVT, DVT, PVT), BOM and ECO management, and CM and JDM operations
Experience working with international manufacturing and supply partners at executive levels
Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insights and craft clear executive presentations
Strong organizational skills: prioritization, attention to detail, and triage of complicated issues
Self-motivated, proactive problem solver who is comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
Hands-on experience applying AI tools, agents, or automation (for example LLM-based workflows, scripting, or low-code tools) to streamline recurring work, or a demonstrated passion for learning to do so

Experience with IoT, telematics, or connected hardware, including accessories, cables, and sensors
Experience with ERP, PLM, and planning systems (for example NetSuite) and SQL or Python for data analysis
Experience building internal tools or agents that other team members adopt

title: Assembly Technician
description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is America's largest manufacturer of AI-native industrial robots. Full-stack robots—hardware, software, and AI—all designed and assembled in Glen Cove, New York. The company makes AI-native robots anyone can buy and deploy, with customers ranging from family-owned machine shops to the Fortune 500. Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.


About the role

You'll build the robots that are showing up on factory floors across the country. Standard Bots is moving fast from prototype to high-volume production, and the people on the assembly line are the most important people in the building — this role sits right at the center of that. You'll work alongside the Production Supervisor and the engineering team, turning parts into precision robotic systems that are ready to work.

📍 Location

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Glen Cove, NY manufacturing facility, working first shift, Monday through Friday. We're unable to sponsor visas for this role.


What you'll do

- Assemble production robots and components to spec, following work instructions — hands-on work that takes a pile of parts and turns it into a finished machine.

- Run quality checks throughout the build, not just at the end, and report issues to the Production Supervisor as soon as you spot them.

- Keep your workspace safe and organized, in line with company and industry standards.

- Handle material movement and distribution to workstations so the line keeps running.

- Contribute to continuous improvement on the production floor — if you see a better way to build, we want to hear it.


What you'll bring

- A high school diploma or equivalent.

- 2+ years in a mass production or manufacturing environment.

- 1+ year of hands-on assembly, maintenance/repair, or tool experience.

- The ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

- Sharp attention to detail — you catch things, and you don't let things slide.

- Clear communication: you flag issues quickly and work well within a team.

- The ability to prioritize and stay focused when things are moving fast.

- A habit of showing up every shift ready to execute, and pride in clean, accurate assembly work.


Nice to have

- An Associate's or Bachelor's degree.

- Experience in automotive, aerospace, industrial, or electromechanical manufacturing.

- Machine shop or CNC equipment experience.

- Familiarity with OSHA standards and workplace safety practices.


Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this role is $30.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

description:

Technical Design and Implementation Effectively leads and collaborates in planning, decomposing, estimating, scheduling, prioritization and resource allocation exercises. Takes the lead on prototype efforts for complex problems. Builds incrementally, with an eye toward vision of the final product. Provides transparency in approach and progress, throughout the process.
Leads the Development Team through the solution design process. Participates in requirements gathering and backlog refinement, takes the lead in shaping and guiding systems approach, drives project initiation, contributes to functional design, and leads technical design and development.

Automates test coverage per platform capabilities and requirements. Establishes and maintains continuous build and integration testing on applicable platforms and assists with manual system and integration testing efforts.
Contributes to and drives deployment approach, including planning and execution, data conversion approach, script development and execution, warranty period and transition of the solution to the platform's operational context.
Operates in both waterfall and Agile Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes and methodologie

Identifies, influences, sells and prioritizes innovative platform opportunities, as well as technical debt, with regular reviews, creating programs and solutions to raise the level of the platform offering or remediate systemic operational problems.
Leads partnership efforts with cross functional teams, such as Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, QA and key Development teams, to strengthen and elevate the platform from a technology perspective. Successfully sees designs and solutions through enterprise processes and governance to ensure compliant, secure and supportable solutions.
Deepens vendor relationships to understand and influence vendor product offerings and roadmaps, improve support engagement and gain insight into technology trends.
Contributes to the platform development community by providing input, content and feedback on design patterns, coding standards, and shared libraries.

Supervises delivery of other developers on the team by setting priority and guiding deliverables.
Keeps projects on course by coordinating activities, monitoring project schedules and costs.
Effectively and efficiently analyzes options in a team setting to make sound decisions. Partners with vendors to improve delivery model and ensure success.

Coaches and mentors other application developers learning new skills and technologies.
Exhibits leadership courage with respectful, articulate positions to influence critical technology solutions.

Tracks and communicates planned and in-flight business capability efforts, leads and influences approach, scoping exercises and resource estimation.
For a medium to large area of the business capability portfolio, responsible for rationalizing, designing and overseeing solution changes in the sustainment process.

Leads and trains partners in collaboratively and effectively diagnosing, troubleshooting and remediating incidents and problems to support the end user community.
Initiates and leads root cause analysis efforts to identify and implement solutions to operational issues.
Creates and maintains operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) on items such as performance, service incidents and tickets set forth by the organization leadership. Identifies systemic problems that need holistic solutions and feedback into platform roadmap exercises.
Ensures documentation supporting training, system administration, deployment, and operational processes and procedures are created and well maintained.
We’d love to hear from people with:

8-10 years of professional industry experience with software development in Oracle OTM, Oracle ERP Supply Chain space.
2 years of leading teams of four or more software developers
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
Preferred Qualifications
Technical Proficiency
Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and computer science concepts relative to the platform.
Mastery of relevant development languages, tools, frameworks, utilities and technical dependencies.
Understanding of implications from design and implementation choices toward building secure, scalable, durable, flexible, accessible solutions.
Ability to write and value high quality, reusable software with minimal defects.
Aptitude to pick up new technologies and trends, as they become relevant for the business and our platforms. Examples include IoT, Big Data, REST Services, mobile, and incorporating cloud components.
Thorough understanding of data transport mechanisms and integrations including synchronous, asynchronous, bulk data, tightly and loosely coupled methods

Thorough understanding of application architecture, infrastructure and security concepts and technical implementation.
Ability to analyze, diagnose and propose solutions to user problems.
Ability to understand and escalate technical challenges with options and recommendations

Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), including Oracle Analytics Publisher reporting capabilities, for report development and support within the OTM/GTM environment.

title: Team Lead, Readiness & Response
description:
As a Team Lead for Readiness and Response within Zoox’s Fleet Operations organization, you are at the forefront of the autonomous mobility revolution. You will be a key leader in our expansion into new markets, responsible for the end-to-end operational integrity of the Zoox Robotaxi and Mapping Vehicle Fleet. This role unifies the technical preparation of our vehicles (Readiness) with high-level oversight of live field incidents (Response), ensuring every Zoox vehicle is "service ready" and every mission is supported with operational excellence. Your leadership will bridge the gap between structured depot workflows and the dynamic environment of real-time fleet response. Rather than performing hands-on technical tasks, you will drive strategy and performance by managing a hybrid workforce of Full-Time Shift Leads and contingent associates. Serving as the primary on-site escalation path for critical field incidents and holding third-party recovery partners accountable, you will directly impact Zoox’s fleet availability, safety standards, and our ability to deliver a seamless experience to our riders.   Shift: 1st Shift, 7am - 4pm, Tuesday - Saturday   Travel Requirements: less than 20% In this role, you will:
  • Collaborate with Leadership: Work with Fleet Ops leaders in market, as well as Fleet Ops Program Teams, to ensure optimization of fleet utilization while driving market needs.
  • Drive Unified Fleet Strategy: Oversee the execution of operational strategies for both vehicle preparation (Readiness) and incident response (Response), ensuring alignment with broader organizational uptime goals.
  • Lead through Shift Leadership: Directly manage and mentor FTE Shift Leads & a contingent workforce, empowering them to oversee daily floor operations while you focus on high-level strategy, performance coaching, and site-wide operational health.
  • Manage On-Site Escalations: Serve as the primary leadership escalation path for critical field incidents and service interferences, providing guidance to the team and making high-level decisions to resolve complex vehicle or rider issues.
  • Manage a Hybrid Workforce: Provide administrative and people leadership for a multidisciplinary team, including onboarding, training, and performance management for contingent (contract) workforces.
  • Coordinate Third-Party Vendors On The Ground: Serve as the local point of contact for vehicle recovery, roadside assistance, and facility vendors — verifying on-site service quality and response time, and flagging no-shows, defects, or service misses to the relevant Program team, who owns vendor standards, governance, and corrective action.
  • Optimize Operational Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in depot workflows (software deployment, sensor cleaning), field response protocols, and work with cross-functional partners to implement process innovations to reduce vehicle downtime.
  • Ensure Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Oversee adherence to all health and safety policies (OSHA) within the workshop and ensure all vehicle documentation and "Up/Down" status reporting are accurate and audit-ready.
  • Synthesize Operational Data: Own the analysis and reporting of site-specific KPIs, providing leadership with data-driven insights into fleet health, team efficiency, and vendor performance.
    • Qualifications
  • 8+ years of relevant work experience in an operations-based environment
  • Experience Managing People Leaders: Demonstrated ability to manage and develop direct reports at the Shift Lead or Supervisor level.
  • Contingent Workforce Management: Extensive experience leading, onboarding, and managing the performance of contractor or contingent workforces.
  • Vendor & Partner Management: Demonstrated experience managing 3rd party service providers and holding external partners accountable to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Critical Thinking under Pressure: Ability to manage high-priority escalations and make sound, data-driven decisions in fast-paced or ambiguous situations.
  • Technical Aptitude: Ability to understand complex technical systems (autonomous vehicle hardware/software) to effectively lead technical teams and communicate with engineering stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Experience facilitating Lean Six Sigma projects or similar methodologies to improve operational efficiency.
  • Safety Excellence: Commitment to maintaining a culture of safety and compliance; must have a clean driving record.

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field (business management, operations, finance, etc.)
  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, or a similar safety-critical industry
  • Experience in a fast-paced and dynamic service environment.
  • Experience with Lean Six Sigma or other process optimization methodologies.
  • Familiarity with fleet management software.
